messages:
jess (support): FYI customer Ryan from GistCo reports their March invoice shows ~2x token usage for streaming sessions. They say they disconnected mid-stream and then client reconnected — billing spiked. attaching logs from their app (sdk v0.12.1) and our request IDs: req_8a3f, req_8a40

matt (eng-oncall): Thanks. Can you paste the raw SSE transcript or a minimal repro? Any server logs showing final-frame events?

jess (support): Pasting sanitized SSE from customer (timestamps removed):

```
data: {"chunk_id":"a1","delta":"Hello "}

data: {"chunk_id":"a2","delta":"world","tokens":5}

data: {"chunk_id":"a3","delta":"","final":true,"tokens":2}


# client disconnects here and reopens connection

# on reconnect we see repeated final: true frame

data: {"chunk_id":"a3","delta":"","final":true,"tokens":2}
```

jess (support): Their app logs show the SDK attempted to resume and the server resent last final frame (same chunk_id). They say invoice shows tokens for the final chunk twice for about 120 session IDs.

anya (billing): I pulled the ledger for invoice INV-5419 — token delta aligns with duplicated ledger entries for the streaming route (route: /v1/stream). Entries reference two different request_ids (req_8a3f and req_8a40) but same customer session meta. We can credit but want root cause first.

leo (eng-ml): Possible explanations: 1) our metering treats each SSE 'final' event as a terminal billing event and doesn't dedupe by session id when a reconnect creates a new request_id. 2) SDK resends cached final chunk on resume. Which side resends needs confirmation.

matt (eng-oncall): Can you repro locally? I can simulate a client that closes the connection after receiving mid-stream KV cache, then reopens with the same "session_id" header. If the server emits final again we can confirm double-bill path.

jess (support): Repro steps provided by customer (simplified):

1) open SSE POST /v1/stream with header `x-session-id: gistco-123` using Node SDK v0.12.1
2) read 2 chunks, close socket abruptly
3) reopen new SSE connection with same `x-session-id` within 10s
4) observe final chunk emitted again and billing events for both req ids

devex: Note — we recently shipped SDK change that caches the final piece for network resumption (PR #892). Version 0.12.1 includes a resume helper that may push the last chunk on reconnect.

leo (eng-ml): That matches. Metering rules: we cut billing when a response sets `final=true` AND request_id completes. If a resumed request_id gets the same final frame it's billed again. We need to de-dupe on `session_id` + model + prompt-hash for a short window to avoid double billing.

matt (eng-oncall): Short-term: propose issuing credits to affected invoices (anya), and a playbook to detect duplicated final frames during billing pipeline reingestion. Long-term: patch metering to drop final frames if we already observed identical final token counts for the same session_id within 60s.

anya (billing): I'll prepare credits for the 120 session IDs; need a CSV of affected request_ids + invoice ids. Jess can you collect and open a billing ticket?

jess (support): On it. I'll collect request ids and send CSV to billing. Ticket: #SUP-2147 assigned.

matt (eng-oncall): Engineering action items:
- leo: propose a lightweight dedupe in meter-collector (match on session_id + final_digest) and return 409 for duplicate final frames so we don't emit tokens twice.
- devex: add warning to SDK docs about resume behavior and release patch v0.12.2 that does not re-emit cached final by default.
- infra: add alert for sudden token spikes per-session (threshold > 2x in 1h).

leo (eng-ml): Draft patch ready, simple in-memory LRU for 60s window. Will open PR and tag eng-oncall.

devex: I'll prepare SDK hotfix and changelog entry. Recommend we put an automated test that simulates reconnects and asserts single final-metering event.

matt (eng-oncall): Thanks — for now @anya proceed with credits, @jess confirm affected customers are notified. I'll monitor for similar reports.

jess (support): Notifying Ryan now and attaching expected credit. He responded: "Thanks — appreciate the quick response, will watch next invoice." :thumbsup: 

dev-bot: deployed meter-collector hotfix to staging (build bc94f), running end-to-end tests.

matt (eng-oncall): Will merge patch to prod after passing canary. Reopen thread if we see recurring cases.

jess (support): Closing loop for SUP-2147 after credits processed. Follow-up scheduled in 48h for post-deploy verification.
